operators.why: Every root, scripts/, scripts/rig_simulator/ and deploy/ .ps1 parses under Windows PowerShell 5.1, the rig's shell (workflow_ps1_encoding covers pwsh 7); pwsh-only syntax fails here instead of on the rig day.
Every scripts\, deploy\ and tools\ source file a root .cmd launcher or operator .ps1 points at exists with that exact spelling, so a renamed script cannot strand a launcher.
The final V1 gate runs on this Python and this OS and answers BLOCKED for a manifest with every gate pending; it emits its verdict as JSON, never a traceback.

The read-only V1 readiness smoke reaches a verdict against a live backend and worker: checkout comparison, both health probes and the voice status probe run end to end. Exit 1 is allowed because the simulator has no ASR/TTS runtime; a traceback or missing JSON is not.

The recovery_soak collector (gate 9) takes one probe against a live stack and an advancing heartbeat file, and journals a line in which all four health flags hold (backend, worker incl. /health/full, advancing heartbeat, no tool-gate state error); the gate's collector has otherwise never run outside the rig.

The gate 8 rig driver accepts a just-written WAV, reaches the worker and reports its outcome as JSON. The simulated worker has no voice runtime and the latency route is dormant, so the driver must fail closed: exit 2 and a JSON object with ok=false, never a traceback. The expectation flips to ok=true the day the simulator carries a voice runtime.

pending.why: The gate 2 operator (#2407) is not on main yet; once it lands, the simulator runs it against the stack with a dev CognitiveProfile and expects a verdict JSON.
Gate 1 needs GitHub Actions check-run reads for four repositories (#2408); the simulator has no token by design. Covered by the qualifier's contract test.
Needs a driver run record from the rig speaker path; the simulator exercises the driver and leaves the qualifier to its contract test until a simulated run record exists.
Gate 4 evidence is produced in Ternedal/VoiceRig with CUDA synthesis and human listening; nothing to simulate here beyond the contract test.
Body gate, deferred under release_scope v1 (ADR-SYS-001); evidence comes from Ternedal/BodyRig.
Body gate, deferred under release_scope v1 (ADR-SYS-001); evidence comes from Ternedal/BodyRig.
Assembles the V1 manifest from the four verifiers' verdicts (#2400 adds repository_authority); a simulated set of verdict files is the next slice.
Binds gate 2 evidence into the manifest; runs after the gate 2 operator can be simulated.
Asks GitHub for tag ownership and exact-head CI while the token is in hand (#347); the simulator has no token by design and a tokenless run answers NOT FROZEN, which proves nothing.
